html:
The Iconic Chill Spots in Saigon Tour, operated by Vietlook Travel, is designed especially for international visitors who would like to explore Ho Chi Minh City from a local and cultural perspective. This tour brings you beyond the well known attractions and introduces you to hidden corners, historic neighborhoods, and relaxed city spaces where local people live, work, and socialize.

Throughout the journey, you will experience the contrast between modern urban development and traditional daily life. From scenic river views and contemporary architecture to old residential areas, floating markets, and authentic street food, this tour offers a balanced combination of sightseeing, culture, and leisure. It is an ideal choice for travelers who want to understand the story, lifestyle, and spirit of Saigon in a comfortable and enjoyable way.

TOUR SCHEDULE

08:00 PM – 12:00 AM
01:00 PM – 05:00 PM
06:00 PM – 10:00 PM

Partner Price: 42 USD per person

TOUR HIGHLIGHTS AND ITINERARY

Saigon River Tunnels

Visit a newly developed urban area along the Saigon River, where you can enjoy spectacular views of District One. This location is well known for its beautiful cityscape and is an excellent place for photography, especially in the evening.

Thu Thiem Bridge – Little Singapore of Saigon

Experience the modern skyline of Thu Thiem and learn why this area is often referred to as Little Singapore. Your guide will explain the history, planning, and development that have shaped this part of the city.

Nguyen Hue Walking Street

Walk along Nguyen Hue Street and discover its transformation over more than one hundred and fifty years. Your guide will share stories about how it changed from a canal into a boulevard and later became the main pedestrian street in the heart of the city.

Old Gangster Area in District Four

Explore District Four, once known as the old gangster area of Saigon. Learn about its historical background, social changes, and how it has evolved into a vibrant local community.

Vietnamese Baguette, Banh Mi

After exploring District Four, stop at a well known local banh mi shop to enjoy one of the best Vietnamese baguettes in the area.

Little Floating Market and Fresh Coconut

Visit a small floating market where local people trade directly from boats. Enjoy a fresh coconut while observing daily life and business activities on the river.

Flower Market Experience

Visit a traditional flower market and learn about Vietnamese flower culture. You will also have the opportunity to create a beautiful lotus flower arrangement by yourself. The lotus is the national flower of Vietnam.

Oldest Apartment Building Built in 1968

Enter one of the oldest apartment buildings in Ho Chi Minh City, built in 1968. Experience the authentic atmosphere of local life and gain insight into the daily lifestyle and culture of Saigonese residents.

Original Local Coffee Shop

End the tour at a traditional local coffee shop where you can enjoy Vietnamese coffee and experience its original and distinctive flavors.
